positive_convergence_deltas: Full semantic Hyperposition carrier fields v/K/E+/E-/F/T/A/sigma plus projection state are fail-closed validated.
Caller relation/target/winner fields are rejected and branch relations are derived from formal task-world context, predictions and observed outcomes.
Correlation ancestry, payload identity and independence-group reuse are checked against accumulated branch evidence.
Branch birth comes only from formal task-world rules, not a caller branch payload.
Merge uses exact formal semantic signature rather than embedding similarity.
Discriminator ordering derives pair separation from branch predictions and remains ordinal/nonprobabilistic.
Salience remains attention ordering only and has no truth/probability/evidence-strength/resolution authority.
Task-local resolution is explicitly typed as synthetic-world resolution and does not mint canonical truth/effect/runtime/training credit.

promotion_blockers.observed: EVENT_SCHEMA requires event.independence_qualified as a caller-provided boolean. _novelty correctly blocks exact event, ancestry, payload and independence-group reuse, but it also grants novelty only by consulting this caller field. A novel-looking event with independence_qualified=true can therefore receive independent credit without an independently recomputed causal/dependence certificate.
promotion_blockers.consequence: The noninvented-label chain remains incomplete at the evidence-independence boundary.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Remove independence_qualified from model/generator authority. Derive it from a source-bound dependence certificate/event registry or verify a certificate whose rule+inputs+digest are independently recomputed by the gate.

promotion_blockers.observed: _novelty treats any previously seen event_id as EXACT_EVENT_REPLAY. u_state then performs an idempotent no-op. No v3 check binds event_id to an immutable digest of ancestry/group/payload/provenance/test/outcome/epistemic type before taking the replay path.
promotion_blockers.counterexample: Reuse a prior event_id while changing payload_key, observed_outcome or provenance. The replay marker can suppress the conflict instead of failing closed.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Persist canonical event_digest in evidence records; same event_id + same digest is idempotent, same event_id + different digest is hard corruption failure. Preserve the stronger v2 mutation guard and extend it beyond relation/ancestry.

promotion_blockers.observed: Formal world test specs require allowed_outcomes, mismatch_effect and ordinal risk/cost/coordination ranks, but no explicit admissible/observable/executed field or source-bound execution receipt. d_resolve can resolve after a FALSIFIES event solely from resulting state plus independent support.
promotion_blockers.consequence: For curriculum-synthetic worlds this may be a deliberate closed-world simplification, but it does not yet satisfy the stronger Trigger-2 D contract that collapse occurs only after an adequate admissible discriminator/proof covers live applicable alternatives.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Either declare/validate an explicit formal-world law that every registered test is admissible and executable in that synthetic world, or add admissibility + execution/observation receipt and require it in resolution provenance.

promotion_blockers.observed: Each test declares mismatch_effect=COUNTERS or FALSIFIES. This is safer than per-row caller relations because it is source-bound task-world semantics, but the decisive/nondecisive property is encoded directly as a relation label.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Prefer a typed test property such as decisive_for_claim=true/false plus explicit claim/test semantics, then derive COUNTERS versus FALSIFIES mechanically. If mismatch_effect is retained, bind and mutation-test it as part of the formal-world proof ontology rather than treat it as generic metadata.

promotion_blockers.observed: epistemic_guard accepts evidence_qualified_observation as a boolean argument when deciding whether UNKNOWN/HYPOTHESIS/PREDICTION/etc. may become OBSERVED.
promotion_blockers.consequence: GRF/E reference labels can remain circular unless that boolean is produced by the same source-bound evidence qualification chain.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Bind E transitions to typed observation/proof receipts rather than a naked boolean. UNKNOWN remains distinct from ZERO/ABSENT/FAIL.

promotion_blockers.observed: The current 247-line source test suite covers derived relations, caller relation rejection, relation flips, update/resolution, soft counters, exact replay idempotence, ancestry/payload repackaging, projection, branch birth, merge, discriminator ranking, permutation and GRF guard. It does not test same-event/different-payload-or-outcome corruption, forged independence_qualified=true, or nonadmissible/nonexecuted discriminator behavior.
promotion_blockers.required_successor: Add explicit mutation regressions for these three classes before v3 can become the positive D/E reference root.

versioning_effect.reason: Ledger v5 observed main before the converged v3 labeler and therefore still names an unmateralized convergence successor as the frontier.
versioning_effect.reason_detail: Protocol v3 also wrote immediately before v3 landed; its next action is partially superseded by the new source, but its independence/gate requirements remain valid.

external_research_alignment.implication: Training can pass through shallow shortcut phases before systematic binding; keep checkpoint/family/distractor and causal tests rather than treating aggregate improvement as proof of the desired mechanism.
Mean positive steering effect can hide high sample variance and opposite-sign effects; vector control requires held-out reliability/off-target controls.
Behaviorally equivalent steering interventions need not identify a unique semantic vector; preserve equivalence Hyperposition until structural/multi-environment discriminators separate them.

next_exact_action: Harden v3 rather than create another labeler lane: derive/verify independence from immutable event/dependence receipts, bind event_id to canonical event digest and fail on mutation, make discriminator admissibility/execution/coverage explicit, bind GRF OBSERVED promotion to typed evidence receipt, add the corresponding mutation tests, then update the ledger and derivation-bound gate to exact v3 bytes before regenerating positive Hyperposition-native C1/D/E candidates.
